rows.applicability_condition: The organization performs the provider function for an identified high-risk AI system whose applicable conformity route invokes Annex VII point 3.2.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Scoped Kubernetes artifacts may contribute provider evidence for the quality management assessment. The notified body performs the assessment and issues its decision.
rows.framework_requirement_title: Conformity based on an assessment of the quality management system and an assessment of the technical documentation

rows.applicability_condition: The identified high-risk AI system and approved quality management system are subject to applicable Annex VII surveillance and the evidence is available to the notified body.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Retained platform artifacts can support the surveillance audit within the agreed scope. The notified body conducts periodic audits and issues the report.
rows.framework_requirement_title: Conformity based on an assessment of the quality management system and an assessment of the technical documentation

rows.applicability_condition: The collected records are used by an adopted AI risk management process with documented risk priorities.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: The evidence register can support transparent records of scoped platform controls and observed outcomes. Validate the approved risk process and the connection to its priorities.
rows.framework_requirement_title: The risk management process and its outcomes are established through transparent policies, procedures, and other controls based on organizational risk priorities.

rows.applicability_condition: The evidence cadence and ownership are used in the organization’s planned review of AI risk management.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Recurring checks and freshness tracking can support the planned monitoring and review. Verify accountable roles, review cadence, and recorded decisions.
rows.framework_requirement_title: Ongoing monitoring and periodic review of the risk management process and its outcomes are planned, organizational roles and responsibilities are clearly defined, including determining the frequency of periodic review.

rows.applicability_condition: The deployed assessment identifies actual in-scope AI system components including relevant third-party AI technology and ties each relevant component to documented internal risk controls.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Retained component-linked records can support documentation of identified internal risk controls. Verify the component inventory, the specific controls, and their implementation evidence.
rows.framework_requirement_title: Internal risk controls for components of the AI system, including third-party AI technologies, are identified and documented.

rows.applicability_condition: The repository retains actual in-scope audit records for the defined duration and supports authorized retrieval.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: The archive can preserve selected audit records where the retention policy and retrieval are verified against the required period.

rows.applicability_condition: An authorized assessment plan selects these controls and uses these provenance-linked records as evidence.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Use timestamped observations as inputs to an assessment. Preserve the assessor’s method, test results, findings, and reviewer decisions.

rows.applicability_condition: Tracked findings feed an approved system plan of action and milestones with remediation records.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: A readiness dashboard can surface gaps to the accountable owner. Verify that assessed findings, planned actions, milestones, and updates appear in the system plan.

rows.applicability_condition: An approved integration keeps the actual system plan of action and milestones accurate, current and available.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Verify that the scoped finding and status propagate with correct lineage to the plan and remain available to its authorized consumers.
rows.framework_requirement_title: Automation Support for Accuracy and Currency

rows.applicability_condition: The system monitoring strategy defines the relevant metrics, frequencies, ownership and reporting, and the pipeline operates within that strategy.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Recurring collection and freshness alerts can support system continuous monitoring. Verify scope, cadence, response and reporting against the approved strategy.

rows.applicability_condition: The implemented automation maintains the accuracy, currency and availability of results for the selected monitoring scope.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Verify that the consumer receives exact current results, detects stale or missing data, and retrieves retained records.

rows.applicability_condition: A governed post-change review uses the evidence to verify operation and outcomes for impacted controls.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Versioned records can support post-change verification. Verify the relevant control behavior and retained decision for the specific change.

rows.applicability_condition: The scoped component and control records are incorporated into the system security and privacy plans.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Use versioned configuration evidence to support referenced plan content and verify that approved plans cover required components and operating context.

rows.applicability_condition: The organization uses dated evidence in its approved testing and monitoring planning process.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Results can support the monitoring portion of the program plan review. Verify the program’s approval, update and execution records.

rows.applicability_condition: The governed design process incorporates the collected artifacts into sufficient system security documentation.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Use versioned records and provenance to substantiate the selected system documentation. Verify coverage of the design and its review.

rows.applicability_condition: The pipeline delivers actual security or privacy function verification results to the designated recipients.
rows.framework_mapping_notes: Distinguish the result of a function check from an inventory observation. Verify the recipients and delivered verification record.
